verdict.rationale: Clerky is a startup formation and legal-paperwork platform, so a registered-agent and digital-mail service is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers formations, IRS filings, bank applications, equity, a Partner API and an MCP server. Nothing in it mentions acting as a registered agent, scanning legal mail, or forwarding service of process.

support.subject: As a founder, I can use the platform as my registered agent and receive scanned legal mail and service of process digitally
